entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The recurring failure is treating the partition criterion itself as the contribution while leaving its value unproven. Papers propose a sensitivity or redundancy discriminator — roundtrip distortion, weight magnitude, activation overlap, double-rounding, subspace projection — and reviewers immediately map it onto an established technique (PCA/SVD on activations, a layer-norm-equivalent rescaling, structured dropout, classical feature distillation), so the differentiated treatment reads as a relabeling rather than a new mechanism.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Presenting a sensitivity or redundancy proxy as the novelty invites the verdict that it rediscovers known mixed-precision or low-rank results unless it is sharply differentiated from the obvious prior criterion.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The candidate makes independently addressable residual rungs and task-conditioned exact-byte allocation, but its stated deltas predate and do not sharply distinguish the directly competing SpectrumKV and MixKVQ criteria in the collision pool.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Omitting comparison against both the strongest uniform baseline and the obvious cheap alternative (SVD/PCA, structured dropout, a natively trained smaller model) leaves reviewers unable to tell whether the partition buys anything at all.

entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The recurring failure shape is adopting a conditioning recipe known to work in one domain and porting it to a new modality or task family without any theory for why the conditioning signal carries task-relevant structure there, then reporting only modest gains over strong baselines. The headline 'training-free,' 'zero-shot,' or 'held-out generalization' claim is undercut because the experimental setup quietly violates its own premise — evaluation data or near-duplicates leaked into the upstream or base-model pretraining corpus, the method needs idealized access (the exact base checkpoint), or the demonstrated scope is a single task with no recipe for finding the analog elsewhere.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Claiming 'fine-tuning-free' or 'zero-shot' while training splits of the evaluation tasks sit inside your upstream corpus makes the comparison unfair and collapses the generalization claim into in-distribution performance.
